~Affiance Casting~.Effect:
Your Max Mana is 2. It never increases and can't increase except through Warlock Talents.
Your Mana replenishes after each Worthy Combat.

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

You may pick 2 Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).

~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade:
1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
You can change your Flux inbetween Adventures.

~Transfusion~.Effect: Give all your Mana to an ally.

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target Ability or Attack targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spent, dealing -50% Damage and Healing to the secondary targets.

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack Single-Stuns one of the Units hit. For each extra Evoke Point spent, Single-Stun it again.
~Overwhelm~.Notes: Alternatively, you can Single-Stun one extra Unit that was hit, if your Act hit multiple Units. When increasing the Stun Degree inflicted with an Evoke Point, only increase it for one of the hit Units.

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.
~Amplify~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target attack or Spell deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing on cast per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 4 meters away per Evoke Point spent.

~Curse of the Mind~.Duration: Minor curse lasts until end of Adventure
~Curse of the Mind~.Effect:
A Unit is afflicted by minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc), getting -2 on all Checks.
Then, you can deal 5d4 Psychic Damage to it and becomes Deafened or Dazed (its choice).
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Curse of the Mind~.Notes: Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

~Wyrd Suture~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.

~Orbs of Umbra~.Effect:
Summon 1d6 orbs shaped to your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')}, which either orbit you or stay in place where you put them.
Whenever you hit a Unit within 3 meters (with anything else), 1 Umbrablaze may fly into it to deal 1d6 Damage or Healing to it.

At will, you can tap into any of your orbs to see what it is seeing, live, in your mind.
A Recording Eye records everything it sees. You can retrieve it to see everything recorded in it.
~Orbs of Umbra~.Notes: The orbs may fit inside your palm, or may be larger. They are visible, but you can freely decide how they are textured.

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for 1 Action Point, and at Level 7, for 0 Action Points.

~Hail~.Effect: Blast a Unit for 2d8 + ^target's Might^ {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.
~Hail~.Combo: Damages an extra Unit in range with -50% of the original Damage.
~Hail~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage.

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.

~Curse of Lethargy~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of its Turns, it is Slowed.

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.

~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Spells from.
You get 2 free Magic Font Spells.
~Font Magic~.Notes: All Magic Font Spells act like Class Talents. You can get more Magic Font Spells like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.

~Curse of Frailty~._Value: Baseline, 0, but can go up to 1 if used correctly
~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.

~Hail Torrent~.Effect:
Blast a Unit for ~2d10~ + ^target's Might^ {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.

{Evoke}: Hits an extra Unit (for ~1d10~ + ^that Unit's Might^) for each Evoke Point spend.
~Hail Torrent~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters from you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')}, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a 1 Action Point. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage, or use an Item or Default Ability.
Deal 1d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage, or use an Item or Default Ability.

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, all Damage you deal is increased by 50%. Every time you deal 10 or more Damage in one instance, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Notes: The 50% increase is not applied to the 5 Psychic Damage.

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points applied to both.

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.

~Translation~.Effect: You can understand any spoken or written language that's either Common (Dwarvish, Elvish) or Wild (spoken by "wild", tribal socities, such as Orcish, Goblan, Sylvan, etc).

~Decaying Blight~.Effect:
Channel to spawn a blight that spreads a 1x1 meter space away from a chosen space for each 2 Action Points channeled.
The blight kills small plants, insects and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust and decays food and poisons water.
You can channel a number of times (Actions) equal to your Level.
While within the Blight, you have +1 to all non-combat Rolls.
~Decaying Blight~.Notes:
You can choose to ommit some of the effects of this blight.
This Ability is not meant for combat.
Be creative with how you use this little Spell!

<Final Word>.Effect: When you have exactly 1 Mana, and you cast a Spell that cost 1 Mana, that Spell casts twice (for free).
<Final Word>.Notes: This is akin to casting the Spell again for 0 Action Points without spending Mana (not necessarily on the same target).

<Invoke Old God>.Effect:
You bring forth into the mortal realm a manifestation of your source of power - an old god from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`.
You do not control it - it has its own Turn in combat with a Setback of 1d4 and possesses its own will. What will you compromise to forcefully drag an unknowable entity into the mortal plane?
Also, passively, you gain +2 Intelligence and Sense, and you automatically pass all Impossible Intelligence Checks (requiring at least 25).
<Invoke Old God>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<The Dark Ritual>.Effect:
Spend any amount of Mana. Your next Spell has +50% Damage, Heal, area diameter and range for each Mana spent.
After that, restore all your Mana.
<The Dark Ritual>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
